title: Elf Bar 600 Blueberry Raspberry Prefilled Vape Pods 20mg - 2PK
description: These Elf Bar 600 Blueberry Raspberry Prefilled Pods are designed for the Elf Bar 600 Prefilled Pod Kit, delivering an easy and flavourful vape. Each pod comes prefilled with 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid, producing a smooth MTL draw and up to 600 puffs depending on usage. The flavour pairs juicy Blueberry with the sharper tang of Raspberry for a bright and balanced fruit mix that remains satisfying from start to finish. Once empty, pods can be replaced in seconds—no refilling or coil changes needed—for a mess-free vaping experience.
